My favourite seafood place in Nha Trang for 10 years
Oct 2023 • Couples
I am having dinner at Tam Meo every time I am in Nha Trang - for ten years now! And I have never been disappointed. The food is fresh, it is cooked nicely and the prices are very acceptable.

Service has always been friendly to us. I cannot confirm the bad reviews about the staff. The restaurant is always busy which is a sign that people like it and to me it means that everything is fresh.

Last night my wife and I had dinner again and we thoroughly enjoyed the evening.

Year after year my favourite seafood place!
Nov 2017 • Couples
We come to Nha Trang for a weeek every year (from Hanoi). Mainly to stuff ourselves with seafood. Our first stop is always Tam Meo. And we have been never disappointed.

Of course, we also hit the track and visit the other seafood "hot-spots" (rated as the best by Vietnamese groups like "foody.vn") So far we have been to 5 of the top addresses. But today and tomorrow (our last evening) we will be back to Tam Meo! What more can I say? They do have the best quality/price offer in Nha Trang.

For us an advantage is that they are at the Southern end of Nha Trang, not so close to the hotels, and you rarely find foreigners there :) That keeps things authentic.

One recommendation: as with all Vietnamese restaurants, service starts to suck when they get busy. Come early and everything will be fine! We always eat at 6pm. Don't order seafood from the menu. Go and choose what you want from the live basins. The price is per kg. Ask for it as e.g. different shellfish have widely different prices...

Our favourite seafood restaurant in Nha Trang
Apr 2016 • Couples
Every time we are in Nha Trang we go to Tam Meo. And usually I am the only foreigner there. The place is always packed - and you chose the life seafood you want and tell them how to prepare it for you.

I always have a kilo oysters for starters - a real bargain at 80,000 Dong. Other favourites of us are deep fried squid and green mustard veggie as a side dish...

The service is attentive and the kitchen is flexible.
We also love the atmosphere of sitting outside.

Good and Bad
Dec 2015 • Family
The first night we went there we ordered a truckload of seafood. Prawns, Fish, another prawn related critter, veg rice etc... It tasted great! The place spills onto the street and seems to be great with the locals and other Asian tourists who came on a tour bus.
We paid about VND 660,000.We went back a second day and although the food tasted great, some of the food we ordered did not arrive, and we also had to argues about the bill... I suggest you go early before all the good stuff is sold out or it gets too busy to provide decent service. Another annoying thing was the peanut lady who just drops the peanuts at your table. We thought they were complementary, but it turned out we had to pay for them at the end. Even though we did not asked for them, we still ate and enjoyed them.
